verdict.rationale: The Mesh case management module lets teams prioritise and review alerts, filter cases by assignee and stage, and record explicit case decisions (no risk / risk accepted / offboard). A case audit-trail endpoint returns the audit log for a case, and the agentic workflows automatically escalate high-risk or complex cases to human review. However, assignment is only implied by an assignee filter, escalation is documented only as AI-to-human handoff, and SLAs are absent. missing for 10: SLA or due-date tracking on cases, documented manual assignment and reassignment between team members, human-to-supervisor escalation or multi-level approval, evidence that the audit trail records who decided and the rationale behind each decision, independent or hands-on corroboration.
